Run administration tasks: roles, directory modes, drift checks, repairs and schemas.

Panel: [Administration](/docs/reference/cli/panels/administration/).

## Usage

```text
huron adm [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

**Access**

| Command                                 | Description                                                                             |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron adm grant`](#huron-adm-grant)   | Give a role to an LDAP group on an organization (`--org`) or a catalog (`--catalog`).   |
| [`huron adm revoke`](#huron-adm-revoke) | Take a role from an LDAP group on an organization (`--org`) or a catalog (`--catalog`). |

**Share**

| Command                                                 | Description                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron adm check`](#huron-adm-check)                   | Report drift between the service and the share. The exit code is 1 when there are findings. |
| [`huron adm verify-mounts`](#huron-adm-verify-mounts)   | Check that the directory of each organization is mounted and has this service's marker.     |
| [`huron adm provision-orgs`](#huron-adm-provision-orgs) | Mark the lake path and prepare each declared organization below its root (storage admin).   |
| [`huron adm repair`](#huron-adm-repair)                 | Repair missing directories and wrong permission bits through the API.                       |

**Schemas**

| Command                                   | Description                   |
| ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |

| [`huron adm assign`](#huron-adm-assign)   | Assign a schema to a catalog. |

## `huron adm grant`

Give a role to an LDAP group on an organization (`--org`) or a catalog (`--catalog`).

You can grant `org_admin` only on an organization. A catalog role on an organization applies
to all its catalogs, existing and future. A grant on a catalog adds to those grants.

```text
huron adm grant [OPTIONS] ROLE GROUP
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type                                                | Description                                                        |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ROLE`   | org_admin \| catalog_admin \| contributor \| reader | `org_admin`, `catalog_admin`, `contributor` or `reader`. Required. |
| `GROUP`  | str                                                 | An LDAP group. Required.                                           |

### Options

| Option      | Type | Default | Description                                                                  |
| ----------- | ---- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--org`     | str  |         | The organization, for `org_admin` or for a catalog role in all its catalogs. |
| `--catalog` | str  |         | The catalog, for a catalog role. The default is the current catalog.         |

## `huron adm revoke`

Take a role from an LDAP group on an organization (`--org`) or a catalog (`--catalog`).

A group that holds a catalog role through the organization of the catalog keeps that role in
all catalogs of the organization. To take that role from the group, revoke it on the
organization with `--org`.

```text
huron adm revoke [OPTIONS] ROLE GROUP
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type                                                | Description                                                        |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ROLE`   | org_admin \| catalog_admin \| contributor \| reader | `org_admin`, `catalog_admin`, `contributor` or `reader`. Required. |
| `GROUP`  | str                                                 | An LDAP group. Required.                                           |

### Options

| Option      | Type | Default | Description                                                                  |
| ----------- | ---- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--org`     | str  |         | The organization, for `org_admin` or for a catalog role in all its catalogs. |
| `--catalog` | str  |         | The catalog, for a catalog role. The default is the current catalog.         |

## `huron adm check`

Report drift between the service and the share. The exit code is 1 when there are findings.

The check starts with the organization directories. It skips the catalogs of an
organization when the marker in its own directory is missing or wrong. It also skips the
catalogs of an organization that the managed service configuration no longer declares, when
the mount prefix is not its share (`org_undeclared`).

```text
huron adm check [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option      | Type | Default | Description                             |
| ----------- | ---- | ------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `--catalog` | str  |         | Check only this catalog.                |
| `--hash`    | flag |         | Also compare the `sha256` of each file. |

## `huron adm verify-mounts`

Check that the directory of each organization is mounted and has this service's marker.

The table has one row for each organization. Its state is `ok`, `missing`, `no marker`,
`wrong instance` or `wrong org`. The exit code is 1 when a state is not `ok`. For an
organization without its own marker, the CLI checks the marker at the mount prefix. An
organization that the managed service configuration does not declare has no known root.
Its state is `undeclared`, and it does not make the check fail.

```text
huron adm verify-mounts [OPTIONS]
```

## `huron adm provision-orgs`

Mark the lake path and prepare each declared organization below its root (storage admin).

The lake path is `mount_prefix` on this machine. The lake path and each root must exist.
The command writes a marker for this service at the lake path. When an organization
directory does not exist, the command creates it. The command sets the mode of the directory
and writes a marker for this service and the organization. You can run the command again
safely.

```text
huron adm provision-orgs [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option          | Type | Default | Description                                                   |
| --------------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--org`         | str  |         | Prepare only this declared organization.                      |
| `--dry-run`     | flag |         | Print the planned steps. Do not change anything.              |
| `--emit-script` | flag |         | Print an equivalent shell script, for roots that `root` owns. |

## `huron adm repair`

Repair missing directories and wrong permission bits through the API.

With an identifier, the API repairs each directory from the catalog to the identifier
(Catalog Admin). It also tries to give the catalog directory its share group. It writes each
`metadata.json` that has wrong content. A draft collection has no directory. With `--org`, the
API repairs the directory of the organization (Org Admin).

The command shows each path that the API changed and each path that it could not repair.
The exit code is 8 when the API could not repair a path.

```text
huron adm repair [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                                                 |
| ------------ | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | `catalog`, `catalog.namespace` or `catalog.namespace.name`. |

### Options

| Option        | Type | Default | Description                                                          |
| ------------- | ---- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--recursive` | flag |         | Also repair each namespace and each collection below the identifier. |
| `--org`       | str  |         | Repair the directory of this organization.                           |

## `huron adm publish`

Publish a schema.

```text
huron adm publish [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

### Commands

| Command                                                 | Description                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [`huron adm publish schema`](#huron-adm-publish-schema) | Publish the next version of a named schema from a JSON file. |

## `huron adm publish schema`

Publish the next version of a named schema from a JSON file.

```text
huron adm publish schema [OPTIONS] ORGANIZATION NAME FILE
```

### Arguments

| Argument       | Type | Description                               |
| -------------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `ORGANIZATION` | str  | An organization, or `platform`. Required. |
| `NAME`         | str  | Required.                                 |
| `FILE`         | path | Required.                                 |

### Options

| Option      | Type | Default | Description                           |
| ----------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `--extends` | str  |         | The ID of the schema that it extends. |
